summary: preinstall DNS beacon exfiltrates username and hostname to oast.fun collector
details: The package declares a preinstall script that executes index.js on `npm install`. The script reads os.userInfo().username and os.hostname() and encodes them into a DNS label of the form `msrc-poc.${user}.${host}.dbg6vplohjpkmtolbi6g18ekofkxjzm4s.oast.fun`, then issues a DNS lookup for that name. The oast.fun host is an interactsh out-of-band collector, and the lookup transmits the installer's OS login name and hostname to that collector automatically at install time, without consent or configuration. The @azure-growth scope resembles an internal Microsoft namespace, consistent with a dependency-confusion beacon targeting internal build systems. No code is fetched or executed from the collector in this version, but installer identity is leaked on every install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
